_what: Which prompt templates are COPIED verbatim into a project at pre-launch, and which are GENERATED from their template by the agent that mints the roster.
_why: A bootstrap list hidden inside a provisioning script stops matching the templates beside it, and the mismatch only surfaces as "project-authority prompt missing" at the seam that needed it. Declared here, a test can hold the two in step.

why.agent-proposal: The mint needs this prompt in order to run, so it cannot be one of the prompts the mint produces.
why.project-prompt-generation: This is the prompt that generates project prompts. It cannot be its own output.

_maintenance: generated[] is derived from the template directory. It fell 35 entries behind during the 2026-08-15/16 migration and the test that exists to catch exactly that was not being run — which is why the guard now runs as part of the full orchestration suite, not beside the file it guards.
